Test "Deere Lawn Tractor Consumer Preference Test" between T1; T2. Method: Online survey with simulated purchase scenario. Participants are shown a description of a lawn tractor (specifications, price, dealer network availability) and asked to choose between two purchase options: (A) a standard residential model sold through existing dealer network at wholesale price; (B) a premium lifestyle model sold through specialty dealers at a 20% higher price point with lifestyle branding. Participants also indicate their primary purchase driver (cost, convenience, status).. Sample: 500 U.S. homeowners with small gardens (under 1 acre) recruited via an online panel, balanced for age, income, and region.. Measure: Proportion of participants choosing option A versus option B; average stated primary purchase driver score (1‑5 scale) for each option.. Predictions: T1: Option A will be chosen by at least 60% of participants; primary driver score for A will be significantly higher than for B (e.g., mean 4.5 vs 3.5).; T2: Option B will be chosen by at least 60% of participants; primary driver score for B will be significantly higher than for A (e.g., mean 4.5 vs 3.5).. Decision rule: If option A is chosen by ≥ 60% of participants and its primary driver score is ≥ 4.0, proceed with a consumer‑focused residential proposition (support T1). If option B is chosen by ≥ 60% and its primary driver score is ≥ 4.0, proceed with a premium‑lifestyle proposition (support T2). If neither condition is met, conclude insufficient evidence and recommend no expansion.. Cost: 15000 euros, 10 weeks.
